This audit approves only current composition/bridge bytes; the frozen ASR, source baseline and independent copied implementation remain unchanged. 2026-09-12 I3 wires owner-bound native subtitle drops, safe global translation summaries and per-document source-directory selection/export; ASR algorithms and shared resource leases remain unchanged. I5 review: fixed owner-bound native media drop authority shares picker authorization/probe; automatic translation coordinator initializes opted-in admission, fences synchronously on shutdown, joins admission before translation disposal, and is injected only by application composition. ASR algorithms and shared resource authority remain unchanged. 2026-09-14 I9 integration review of previously pulled commits 8589872 and 0f6e500: revealSource is schema-validated and owner/liveness-bound, rechecks captured input or authorized source directory before invoking shell; save-dialog publication follows the frozen plan conflict policy and retains platform-aware default-path handling. No ASR algorithm changes. 2026-09-14 P1.1 current composition review: inject a read-only main-process knowledge snapshot into independent Studio trial planning; fixed owner-bound trial IPC freezes requests and joins cancellation/shutdown, with post-await capability fences. Formal translation, automatic admission, ASR algorithms and frozen copied sources remain unchanged. 2026-09-14 P1.2a composition review: add fixed owner-authorized, post-read liveness-checked execution-record pagination. Private frozen plan/request tables stay out of regular document pages; the endpoint returns one retained track batch and no runtime credentials. ASR and shared-resource wiring remain unchanged. 2026-09-14 P1.2b composition review: share one main-process knowledge task gate between formal single-document admission/resume and permanent-clear final inventory; compose read-only current/previous document references with physical run leases. Fixed owner-bound plan/create/cancel methods admit only frozen main-owned knowledge plans; private bodies remain outside document pages. Knowledge planning disposal joins outstanding admissions. Ordinary batch/automatic inputs and ASR/resource ownership contracts are preserved. 2026-09-15 P1.2c current composition review: add three fixed owner-bound batch knowledge methods. Each document uses a frozen main-process plan and the existing knowledge gate; shared batch choices reject cue bindings and confirmations. Cancel/replacement stops remaining admissions and preserves committed task acknowledgements. Shutdown joins single/batch/automatic admission coordinators before disposing translation runs. Frozen ASR copies, resource ownership and ordinary batch contracts are preserved. 2026-09-15 P1.2d reviewed automatic knowledge composition: inject a main-only capture service into the existing transcription runtime; serialize material capture and reference lease publication with permanent clearing. Inventory now merges pending captures, current/previous automatic intents and execution records, and physical requests using distinct identities. Closing fences new captures without discarding held references. Native algorithms, shared speech authority and frozen sources are unchanged. 2026-09-16 P1.2e reviewed bounded automatic preparation diagnostics: fixed owner-authorized read executes before translation initialization, validates identity and returns saved issue excerpts plus credential-free recheck choices. A post-read liveness fence prevents revoked owner delivery. Ordinary pages expose only report track IDs; no frozen knowledge or report body. Shared resource ownership, ASR algorithms and frozen copies are unchanged. 2026-10-07 composition review (6f84227, 5340ade, 50d97b4): Studio document IPC adds owner-bound translation-track rename and cue edit methods, an import filter listing the shared text subtitle formats, and an optional translation plan scope; transcription composition, shared speech resource ownership and shutdown joining are unchanged. 2026-10-09 composition review (AI cue revision and assistant page tools): Studio document IPC adds owner-bound locateCueRevision and reviseCues, which check document authorization and post-await liveness and return a search plan with found cue IDs or revision proposals without writing; cancelCueRevision, which aborts only the caller's own request; and read-only findCues, which searches an authorized document by wording or number without a model. The revision service joins owner release and shutdown. Applying a revision reuses editCues. Transcription composition, shared speech resource ownership and shutdown joining are unchanged. 2026-10-10 composition review (automatic export): compose one main-only automatic exporter over the document repository; the translation service reports completion of the task an automatic intent admitted, and the exporter then writes the document beside its bound source location (no picker, existing source-location verification and publish paths) and records the outcome in the snapshot; the transcription runtime receives it as an injected dependency; shutdown joins outstanding exports after translation disposal. Document pages add the export state summary. ASR algorithms, shared speech resource ownership and frozen copies are unchanged. 2026-10-10 composition review (typed subtitle import): add owner-bound importSubtitlePaths; main collects only subtitle-format files under the given absolute paths (no links followed, bounded by the batch limit) through the neutral electron/main/fs/typed-paths.ts and passes them to the existing owner import, exactly as dropped paths are. The assistant only sends paths the user typed. Transcription composition, shared speech resource ownership and shutdown joining are unchanged. 2026-10-10 composition review (agent-knowledge-loop I2/I3): the AI cue revision service receives the existing read-only main-process knowledge snapshot reader to project the document's chosen materials into revision requests; a new owner-bound, cancellable consistency service (checkConsistency/cancelConsistency) reads only documents this window already owns, joins forgetOwner and shutdown disposal, and writes nothing. No speech resource, ASR, shared authority or frozen copy change. 2026-10-10 studio-cue-structure I1 review: subtitle imports from every entry point (picker, drop, typed paths) pass the read document through interpretBilingualImport before creation, so a clearly bilingual text file is separated into source and imported translation exactly as the existing bilingual step does; a new owner-checked revertBilingual method rebuilds an unedited separated document from its preserved raw text. No transcription, speech resource, ASR or shared authority composition change. 2026-10-11 studio-cue-audio review: four owner-bound methods (getCueMedia, chooseCueMedia, clearCueMedia, readCueAudio) check document authorization and post-await liveness; media paths stay in main (private per-document receipt or user-picked file, identity rechecked before every read) and only file names reach the renderer. readCueAudio decodes one bounded stretch with the bundled, verified media runtime into memory (no temporary files), one decode per window, stopped by a newer request and by forgetOwner/dispose. Choosing another source folder keeps a transcribed document's media as a link first. No transcription, speech resource, ASR or shared authority composition change. 2026-10-11 studio-cue-recognize review: owner-bound recognizeCue/cancelCueRecognition recognize one authorized document's cue again; the cue's original audio is decoded at 16 kHz into a private file under the studio's cue-audio directory (removed afterwards) and passed to the transcription runtime's new studio-owned recognize.clip, which resolves the installed model, verified server runtime and backend as task admission does, holds the shared resource use and a supervisor inference lease for that one request, and releases both. One recognition per window, aborted by a newer request, cancel or owner release. No frozen copy, ASR algorithm or shared authority change. 2026-10-11 studio-cue-shift review: adds the read-only previewCueShift handler after the existing document read and revision check; it counts the cues a whole-document or from-a-cue shift would move and reports why it cannot, using the shared pure cue-shift checks, and changes nothing. The shift itself is a new cue edit operation in cue-edit-service. No transcription runtime, frozen copy, ASR algorithm or shared authority change. 2026-10-11 cue-audio prewarm review: when getCueMedia or chooseCueMedia reports media ready, the studio-owned cue audio clipper starts its existing one-time media runtime verification in the background so the first clip does not wait for it; failures stay quiet and decoding verifies again. No transcription runtime, frozen copy, ASR algorithm or shared authority change. 2026-10-11 studio-cue-split-insert review: adds the read-only suggestCueSplit handler after the existing document read and revision check; it returns when a cue would split at a place in its text (a transcript word start, else the share of the text) from the shared pure cue-split module and changes nothing. Split and insert themselves are cue edit operations in cue-edit-service. No transcription runtime, frozen copy, ASR algorithm or shared authority change. 2026-10-11 studio-cue-find review: adds the read-only searchCues handler after the existing document read and revision check; it finds a literal text in sources and/or one track's translations with the shared pure cue-find module and changes nothing. Replacing is a cue edit operation in cue-edit-service. No transcription runtime, frozen copy, ASR algorithm or shared authority change. 2026-10-12 reviewed the readDocumentPage handler: the document page no longer carries raw source nodes, since the Studio preview dropped its original-content view; source preservation and export are unchanged. No transcription runtime, frozen copy, ASR algorithm or shared authority change. 2026-10-12 translation knowledge v2 review: Subtitle Studio composition drops the knowledge task gate and the knowledge reference inventory; services are constructed without them and no shared-resource wiring changed.
